claims.statement: Quickstart declares FPT/GHEC/GHES and tutorial uses write-access existing/new repository with issues enabled; GHEC EMU qualifier applies. Tutorial prerequisite is not universal minimum for all issue creation methods.
Blank issue is tutorial path; repository may use templates and FPT/GHEC forms. Blank availability must be checked rather than silently bypassing repository intake policy.

Descriptive title and useful purpose/details are recommendations; bug example calls for reproduction steps, expected and actual result. Example fields do not certify truth, independently reproduce defect or become universally adopted mandatory schema.
Markdown task lists can track text tasks and later convert to issues. Text checkbox state is not hierarchy identity, accepted completion or verified remediation.

Assignment communicates responsibility and example question/good-first-issue labels communicate category; eligibility/triage/write and actual suitability remain governed by detailed guides. Tutorial examples are not estate-wide adopted values.

Issue type, existing Project metadata and date-based milestone support classification/association; availability/visibility and lifecycle metrics remain qualified by detailed guides, not enforced delivery proof.
Submit creates uniquely addressed issue; later edits preserve operation-specific authority and potentially removable history. URL existence proves neither policy acceptance nor immutable audit.
Sub-issue shared content describes multilevel relationships; dependency paragraph links Free-Pro-Team latest and detailed FPT/GHEC scope, not GHES availability or blocked-operation enforcement.

Comments/mentions/reference insertion aid communication, not acknowledgment/acceptance. Linked next steps and template guidance remain separately reviewed sources and do not imply full semantic or published assurance.
